reviews.comment: Love her! Took her for pilates this semester and it was fun and low stress! Attendance definitely matters, and there are usually 2 or 3 quick assignments every week, but you can use the textbook for them. We also had a couple group assignments too, but they're all done in class. As long as you show up and do the work it's an easy A!

I had her for Pilates this semester, and she was very sweet! Loved this class. There were weekly quizzes, but we could use the online textbook so they weren't too bad. A few easy group assignments as well. Attendance is mandatory and will affect your grade. Would definitely recommend taking her!

Overall, a really good professor! She takes attendance, lots of group work (she does give you class days to work on), and she is extremely helpful. No extra credit is given, but Professor Bassett is helpful in helping her students be successful. Would definitely take her again.

Lots of group work. Quiz every week and 3 tests based off of online modules. Pretty easy class, just remember to keep up with the deadlines and choose a group that is actually going to contribute to the work because almost every assignment will be done with the same group the entire semester.
Everything is off of quizlet omg easy A
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Spring 2020 was her first semester teaching. She's a younger prof and has an attitude sometimes, but the class is straightforward. Exam reviews highlight what will be on exams - complete and study them and you can make an A. Follow the rubric for writing assignments and you should be fine. The semester group project was manageable.
